title: Corbett Nainital
description: Experience the best of Uttarakhand with a memorable journey through the wild forests of Jim Corbett and the serene lakes and hills of Nainital. Explore the thrill of a jungle safari, discover scenic landscapes, enjoy peaceful lakeside moments, and soak in the charm of the Himalayas.

This tour beautifully combines wildlife, nature, adventure, and relaxation, making it ideal for families, couples, and nature lovers. From spotting wildlife in Corbett to enjoying the picturesque surroundings of Nainital, every day offers something new to discover.
Connect with us for detailed itinerary, package options, and customized travel plans.

itinerary.title: Origin Place – Jim Corbett
itinerary.text: Start your Journey at Suitable Time from Delhi or your origin place. Have Breakfast En route as you will get lots of options in Gajraula. Reach & Check inn , in your Pre-Booked Resort in Jim Corbett National Park. Have Lunch & Merge yourself with the in-House Games & Recreational activities of Resort. Have Dinner & Overnight Stay.

itinerary.title: Explore the Jim Corbett National Park
itinerary.text: Today get to connect with Nature early in the morning by 03 Hrs ride in Gypsy. Apart from wildlife, you will get a chance to see the beauty of Nature. Back to Resort & have breakfast. After lunch, You can go to the local sightseeing places like Garjiya Devi Temple, Kosi River, Dhangari Museum, etc. Back to Resort, have dinner & Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Explore the Dhikala
itinerary.text: Today wake up with excitement of seeing the heart of Corbett named Dhikala. Have Breakfast & get ready for the adventure. Reach the gate by 11-11:30 Am & Board the Cantor & Enter the Dhikala Zone. Have Lunch in the Canteen of Dhikala FRH (by your own), spend sometime exploring the zone & then cantor will drop you back to the gate after 06 Hrs. Back to Resort, have dinner & Overnight stay

title: Corbett Wildlife Safari
description: Immerse yourself in the dense sal forests and pristine grasslands of Jim Corbett National Park with our signature wildlife safari tour package. Designed specifically for nature enthusiasts, birdwatchers, and adventure seekers.

Experience thrilling morning and evening open Gypsy safaris into the celebrated Bijrani or Jhirna zones, accompanied by certified naturalists who track tigers, Asian elephants, leopards, and over 600 species of resident birds.
Relax in a luxury riverside resort by the Kosi River with delicious buffet dining, evening bonfires, and seamless concierge support from GTI Travels Pvt. Ltd.

packageIncludes.title: Riverside Resort
packageIncludes.text: Luxury forest-side or riverside stay with modern amenities, swimming pool, and pristine natural surroundings.

packageIncludes.title: All Meals Included
packageIncludes.text: Daily lavish breakfast and buffet dinners featuring authentic Kumaoni dishes and multi-cuisine favorites.

packageIncludes.title: Open Jeep Safari
packageIncludes.text: Authorized 4x4 open Gypsy safaris with experienced wildlife guide, park permits, and entry fees covered.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jim Corbett & Riverside Relaxation
itinerary.text: Arrive at your pre-booked resort in Corbett. Check-in, enjoy refreshing welcome drinks, and unwind amidst tranquil forest landscapes. Spend your afternoon strolling along the Kosi riverbed or participating in resort recreational games. Evening dinner & overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Morning Jeep Safari & Local Corbett Sights
itinerary.text: Early morning pickup by open 4x4 Gypsy for an exhilarating jungle safari in Corbett Tiger Reserve. Spot wildlife in their natural habitat. Return to the resort for hot breakfast. Afternoon visit to Garjiya Devi Temple and Corbett Museum. Evening bonfire and dinner.

itinerary.title: Morning Nature Walk & Departure
itinerary.text: Wake up to bird melodies and take a refreshing morning walk through the surrounding orchards. Relish breakfast in the resort restaurant. Check-out and head homeward with timeless Corbett memories.

title: Nainital Lake Retreat
description: Escape to the serene hills of Kumaon with our scenic Nainital and Bhimtal lake retreat package. Breathtaking vistas of snow-capped Himalayan peaks, emerald waters, and pine-scented mountain air await you.
Explore the charms of Naini Lake with sunset boating, walk the heritage colonial pathways of the Mall Road, ride the aerial ropeway to Snow View Point, and visit the tranquil seven lakes of Sattal.
Stay in boutique hill-view properties with attentive hospitality, authentic local delicacies, and private vehicle sightseeing included throughout.

packageIncludes.title: Hill View Hotel
packageIncludes.text: Boutique lake-facing or mountain-view property with comfortable heated rooms and panoramic valley vistas.

packageIncludes.title: Daily Breakfast & Dinner
packageIncludes.text: Wholesome morning breakfast and evening multi-cuisine dining prepared with fresh mountain produce.

packageIncludes.title: Sightseeing Transfers
packageIncludes.text: Private car for local Nainital and Bhimtal lake excursions, viewpoints, and temples.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nainital & Evening at Naini Lake
itinerary.text: Drive up the scenic Kumaon hills to Nainital. Check-in at your hotel and relax. In the evening, head down to the famous Naini Lake for a peaceful shikara boating experience during sunset, followed by a casual walk along Mall Road. Dinner & overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Himalayan Viewpoints & Cable Car Ride
itinerary.text: After a hearty breakfast, take the ropeway cable car up to Snow View Point for majestic views of Nanda Devi and Trishul peaks. Visit Lovers Point, Cave Garden, and the sacred Naina Devi Temple. Enjoy evening shopping at the Tibetan Market.

itinerary.title: Bhimtal, Sattal & Naukuchiatal Lakes Excursion
itinerary.text: Full day tour exploring the famous lake district: the picturesque island temple at Bhimtal Lake, the pristine birding forests of Sattal, and Naukuchiatal lake. Return to Nainital for a special evening dinner.

itinerary.title: Corbett Waterfalls & Departure
itinerary.text: Enjoy breakfast overlooking the green hills. Check-out and take a scenic stop at Corbett Falls en route to Kathgodam railway station or Delhi. Return home refreshed and rejuvenated.
